The '''Voon sun''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="TotJC" /> located in the [[Voon system/Legends|Voon system]], a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Krenher sector/Legends|Krenher sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Hyabb-Twith Corridor]],<ref name="Corridor" /> which connected it to the [[Hyabb system/Legends|Hyabb]] and [[Twith system/Legends|Twith systems]].<ref name="TEA Voon" /> The star was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voon/Legends|Voon]], and it illuminated the planet with a [[Temperature/Legends|cool]] glare that appeared [[Color/Legends|blue-white]] from Voon's surface.<ref name="TotJC" />

Shortly before the dawn on a [[Local day/Legends|day]] [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before<ref name="TotJC" /> [[4050 BBY]],<ref name="4000 date">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' establishes that the [[Nelori Marauders]] were active "[[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]" prior to [[Arca Jeth]] becoming a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. In addition, ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' both establish that Jeth had attained that rank by the [[Time/Legends|time]] he participated in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Lorell|victory]] over the [[Lorell Raiders]]. Since ''[[Galaxy at War]]'' dates the defeat of the Lorell Raiders to approximately [[4050 BBY]], the Nelori Marauders must have been active decades prior to that date.</ref> a group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] infiltrated the [[Nelori stronghold|stronghold]] of the [[Nelori Marauders]]<ref name="TotJC" /> band of warriors<ref name="CSWE Nelori">{{CSWECite|II|369|Nelori Marauders}}</ref> and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]<ref name="CSWE Dachat">{{CSWECite|I|160|Dachat}}</ref> on Voon in order to [[Second battle of Voon|attack]] them. Unexpectedly to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], however, the Marauders had retreated into the lower levels of the [[Fortress/Legends|stronghold]], leaving the former to briefly stare at each other in puzzlement as light from the Voon sun pierced the structure's slitted [[Viewport/Legends|windows]] and illuminated its empty topmost levels.<ref name="TotJC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Voon sun was introduced in the ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'', a [[1996]] sourcebook authored by [[George R. Strayton]] and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TotJC" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Voon system, and therefore the star itself, in grid square K-9.<ref name="TEA Voon" />
